headline: Cyber Attack Disrupts Operations at Minebea AccessSolutions
body: A ransomware attack has heavily disrupted Minebea AccessSolutions' manufacturing and logistics networks, previously recognized as Honda Lock Mfg. Co., Ltd. The cyber incident forced an immediate stoppage of production across various sites, severely impacting their workflow. The company is collaborating with cybersecurity experts to navigate the breach and restore system functionality. However, there is currently no estimated timeline for a full return to normal operations.
